annotations.title: Save a captured request as docs

description: Document a real request captured by a tunnel (get its id from list_requests). If an endpoint already covers the route, the response is added to it as an example; otherwise an endpoint is created from the request. Credentials, cookies and signatures are replaced by {{variables}} and only JSON bodies are kept. A response already saved as an example is not duplicated. Use it to document webhooks and calls you have only seen in traffic.

endpoint_id.description: Add the example to this endpoint instead of matching by route. Alternative to method + path.

folder.description: Folder for a newly created endpoint, created by name if missing.

method.description: With path: the endpoint that should receive the example.

request_id.description: Id of the captured request, from list_requests.

tunnel.description: Subdomain of the tunnel that captured the request.

name: save_captured_request
